svg.title: With an effect size of −0.19, the two groups’ amygdala sizes are almost completely mixed
svg.desc: Two overlapping bell curves, means 0.19 standard deviations apart, the ADHD curve slightly to the left; about 92% of the area is shared.
svg.text: With an effect size of −0.19, the two groups’
amygdala sizes are almost completely mixed
Illustration: bell curves 0.19 standard deviations apart. Grey is shared by both groups.
Source: Hoogman et al. 2017, Lancet Psychiatry — see source 1 on this page.
Overlap is this page’s calculation, OVL = 2Φ(−|d|/2); real volumes only roughly follow bell curves.
